purpose: Exact declared architecture-debt ledger. Each entry enumerates concrete file paths for a dependency-direction violation that exists at the refactor base and that the target boundary policy forbids. This ledger is not an allowlist: reconciliation asserts exact set equality against the live scan, so an undeclared equivalent violation, a new importer, a different path, a value-edge upgrade, or a stale entry all fail.

debts.risk: Provider read-boundary mappers depend on an application-layer type, inverting the intended direction infrastructure -> ports/domain. The shared normalized signal contract currently has no domain or port home, so every new provider adapter would reproduce the inversion.
debts.removal_gate: Relocate the normalized signal contract into a domain or port boundary, repoint the three provider mappers and any application consumers, and remove this entry so the external-client policy passes with no declared debt.
